title: Open but un-interacted-with VPN login dialog suppresses Wifi connection password dialog
line: A Wi-Fi password prompt now appears right away even while a VPN login dialog is left open.
explanation: plasma-nm's secret agent in kded kept one global dialog pointer (m_dialog), and processGetSecrets() returned early for every request while it was set. So an untouched VPN secrets dialog left every later request, such as a Wi-Fi password prompt, waiting in the queue until NetworkManager gave up with "No secrets were provided". The change drops the global pointer: each request keeps its own dialog, only a request that already has a dialog is skipped, and the accepted/rejected handlers find their request through the dialog that sent the signal.

commits.message:
kded/secretagent: show a password dialog for every pending request

The agent kept a single dialog and queued every other secrets request
until it was closed, so an idle VPN dialog kept the Wi-Fi password
dialog from appearing. Each request now owns its dialog instead.

BUG: 400760

media.caption: VPN secrets dialog left open, then a Wi-Fi password request sent: no Wi-Fi dialog, the request stays pending
The Wi-Fi password dialog only shows up once the VPN dialog is cancelled
Same steps with the fix: the Wi-Fi password dialog appears at once over the open VPN dialog
Entering the Wi-Fi password answers the Wi-Fi request; the VPN dialog stays open and untouched
